copy.body: Come to our First Saturday service at 12 p.m. at 24301 Telegraph, Southfield, MI. If you prefer your couch, tune into the Hour of Power weekdays at 8:15 a.m. online. Pastor Curtis and Pastor Tammy will greet you and show you how the Word lives today. Click to plan your visit.
